name: SO/Paris
positioning: Art- and fashion-led high-rise hotel between Bastille and Le Marais, with interiors by RDAI, Olafur Eliasson's The Seeing City on the top floors and rooms framing views of Paris and the Eiffel Tower
best_for: Travelers who want sweeping Paris views, including the Eiffel Tower, from their room
Couples and nightlife seekers who want a rooftop restaurant and club in the building

facts.text: SO/ Paris is at 10 Rue Agrippa d'Aubigné in the 4th arrondissement, between Bastille and Le Marais.
The hotel is 2 minutes from Sully-Morland metro station on line 7.
The hotel offers prime access to landmarks like Notre-Dame and Place de la Bastille.
The architectural firm RDAI, represented by Denis Montel, designed the interior spaces.
The lobby has terrazzo flooring with marble inserts and mushroom-shaped pillars.
French-Algerian artist Neïl Beloufa created a circular resin work for the lobby whose appearance changes with the observer's vantage point and the light.
Judith Darmont's REFLECTIONS OF LOVE installation is an immersive digital journey that begins in the lobby and leads to the guest's room.
Staff uniforms are designed by Guillaume Henry, artistic director of the Patou fashion house.
Rooms and suites are spread between the 8th and 14th floors and are categorized by the views they offer.
Rooms feature a spirits cabinet, a bulldog-shaped Bluetooth speaker and a minibar stocked with locally sourced snacks.
Spa Maison CODAGE is run in partnership with CODAGE Paris, a French brand for natural treatments.
Bonnie's glass-roofed club sits above the Seine and hosts sets by DJs.

highlights.text: The Seeing City, an artwork by Studio Other Spaces, Olafur Eliasson and Sebastian Behmann, transformed the bay windows of the restaurant and bar facades on the 15th and 16th floors.
Room and suite categories are designed to frame views of the Eiffel Tower from above.
Artist Thomas Fougeirol created 113 unique photograms and five photomontages for the bedrooms and suites, inspired by his strolls along the Seine.
Bonnie Restaurant, a French brasserie on the 16th floor, has a panoramic terrace.

considerations.text: The spa has few treatment rooms, so it is best to request treatments at check-in.
Only a handful of rooms can accommodate children.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
